source: ToSBase, simulador de habilidades (js/skillsim-0.0.2.js), capturado em 16/06/2016
note: Banco de habilidades embutido no simulador. Valores exibidos pelo site; não são extração do cliente. Gerado por scripts/parse-skillsim-2016.py.

10001.name: Thrust
10001.description: Push the point of your weapon into enemies, performing a strong piercing attack.

10002.name: Bash
10002.description: Inflicts damage to an enemy with a powerful attack.

10003.name: Gung Ho
10003.description: Become determined by temporarily increasing your attack, while decreasing your defense.

10005.name: Pain Barrier
10005.description: Temporarily grants a high resistance to being affected by knock back, knock down or staggered.

10006.name: Restrain
10006.description: Lowers your maximum HP, but your attacks have a high chance of stunning enemies.

10007.name: Pommel Beat
10007.description:
Strike enemies with your sword handle.
Inflicts additional damage on stunned monsters, and partially ignores the defense of small and medium sized enemies.

10008.name: Double Slash
10008.description:
Perform a side slash on enemies.
Enemies affected by the [Bleeding] status take additional damage.

10201.name: Wagon Wheel
10201.description: Perform an upward swing with your weapon, launching the enemy.

10202.name: Cartar Stroke
10202.description: Gather force and smash the ground with weapon to attack enemy.

10203.name: Crown
10203.description: Smack your weapon down on an enemy's head. Temporarily decreases the target's INT and SPR.

10204.name: Cross Guard
10204.description: Take a defensive stance, using your weapon to block. Blocked enemies become vulnerable to Pierce attacks.

10205.name: Moulinet
10205.description: Swing sword around to make continuous attacks.

10207.name: Sky Liner
10207.description:
Slash the enemy sideways. 
Inflict additional damage to enemies affected by [Bleeding].

10208.name: Cross Cut
10208.description:
Slash the enemy sideways. 
Inflict additional damage to enemies affected by [Bleeding].

10206.name: Skull Swing
10206.description: Strike and push the enemy sidewards using the side of your sword. Enemy becomes under the Armor Break status effect.

10209.name: Vertical Slash
10209.description: Lift your sword up and perform a vertical strike downward. Medium and large size enemies suffering a defense reduction from [Skull Swing] take additional damage proportional to the reduced amount of defense. The enemy also takes additional damage according to the number of debuffs in effect.

10101.name: Umbo Blow
10101.description: Use the bump of your shield to attack enemies. Blocking provides additional damage on staggered enemies.

10102.name: Rim Blow
10102.description: Use the edge of your shield to attack enemies. Inflicts additional damage on both petrified and frozen enemies.

10103.name: Swash Buckling
10103.required_stance: OneHandSwordShield, OneHandSpearShield, OneHandSwordDagger, OneHandSpearDagger, RapierAndShield, RapierAndDagger
10103.description: Hit your shield to provoke nearby enemies making them pursue you.

10104.name: Guardian
10104.description: Increases your defense while decreasing your attack. Cannot be used with Gung Ho.

10105.name: Shield Lob
10105.description: Throw shield to attack. Shield drops on target area and you physical defense decreases as much as the epuipment . Shield may be picked up or automatically added to inventory after time limit. Decreased physical defense will be back to normal when the shield is back in inventory.

10106.name: High Guard
10106.description: Change to active stance using shield in front. Block and increases while attack and critical decrease.

10107.name: Butterfly
10107.description: Use shield and sword to make continuous attacks.

10108.name: Umbro Thrust
10108.description: Use the spike on the shield to strike the enemy. Enemy may temporarily lose armor effects.

10301.name: Stabbing
10301.description: Repeatedly stab enemies with your spear.

10302.name: Pierce
10302.description: Pierce enemies with your spear. Deals more hits the larger the enemy is.

10303.name: Finestra
10303.description: Switch into the Window stance to attack. Increases Critical Rate and Block, but decreases Evasion.

10304.name: Synchro Thrusting
10304.description: Use spear and shield to attack enemy. Counter attacks deal additional damage.

10305.name: Long Stride
10305.description: Inflicts damage to an enemy by jumping to your designated location.

10307.name: Spear Lunge
10307.description: Stab the enemy in front of you, and make it more vulnerable to [Pierce] attacks.

10306.name: Throwing Spear
10306.description: Throw your spear to damage an enemy. The spear will stick into the ground where it was thrown, and your physical attack will be decreased based on the equipment's upgrade count until you pick it up. Automatically returns to you after a time limit.

10901.name: Conscript
10901.description: Make a formation that calls on the troops.

10902.name: Phalanx
10902.description: Change to Phalanx formation. Concentrate the block ability of all troops to the 3 at the frontline.

10903.name: Tercio
10903.description: Change to Tersio Formation. Defense is concentrated on the three frontline players and provokes enemy.

10904.name: Winged Formation
10904.description: Change to Crane Wing formation. Rush towards target and defense of enemies within range decrease.

10906.name: Schiltron Formation
10906.description: Change to Schiltron formation. All troops stop and raise their weapon to block enemies.

10907.name: Testuto
10907.description: Switches to the Testudo formation. Increases the defense of all members at the cost of slower movement speed.

10908.name: Change Direction
10908.description: Realign direction of formation to leader's view.

10910.name: Special Force Formation
10910.description: Creates a formation which brings squad members together. The skill cooldown time of the squad members that entered into the formation will be reduced in half. Duration will increase by Skill Level, and the number of members in the squad.

10401.name: Embowel
10401.description: Release a powerful stab into the enemy, then kick it away with your foot.

10404.name: Stomping Kick
10404.description: Trample down on an enemy while in the air or jumping. Increased attack is according to your jump height, your shoes' defense and your armor's evasion.

10411.name: Cleave
10411.description: Release a strong attack on enemies by spinning your body. Increases your critical rate when the attack lands and deals additional damage to a stunned enemy.

10409.name: Helm Chopper
10409.description: Strike the enemy's head, causing it to be stunned.

10405.name: Warcry
10405.description: Shout a warcry that causes your enemies to panic and drop their defense, bolstering your attack proportionally.

10406.name: Frenzy
10406.description: Increases your attack when you keep repeatedly attacking one particular enemy.

10410.name: Seism
10410.description: Earthshake causes enemies to be unable to attack. Enemies have a chance to be stunned.

10407.name: Giant Swing
10407.description: Swing an enemy around, using centrifugal force to throw them away.

10408.name: Pouncing
10408.description: Charge forward while slashing, attacking any enemies that block your way.

10601.name: Impaler
10601.description: Impales a small or medium-type monster with a spear. It is possible to attack other enemies with a skewered enemy.

10602.name: Earth Wave
10602.description: Gather force and smash the ground with weapon to attack enemy.

10603.name: Trot
10603.description: Increases your movement speed while riding.

10605.name: Doom Spike
10605.description: Gather force and strongly stab enemy with tip of spear.

10606.name: Rush
10606.description: Twirl your spear overhead to attack enemies.

10801.name: Jolly Roger
10801.description: Pin down a pirate flag, boosting the abilities of a pirate. Defeat enemies continuously near the flag to trigger a combo. (only triggered when party leader is the Corsair)

10803.name: Keel Hauling
10803.description: Drag and pull enemies captured with Iron Hook. Enemy receives damage each time it is pulled.

10804.name: Unlock Chest
10804.description: Can use key to open a higher level treasure chest.

10807.name: Dust Devil
10807.description: As you spin, attack an enemy repeatedly using a weapon in each hand. The enemy will be immobilized temporarily.

10805.name: Double Weapon Assault
10805.description: Can temporarily connect basic and sword attack.

10808.name: Hexen Dropper
10808.description: Use a weapon in each hand to deal successive strikes on an enemy.

11001.name: Deeds of Valor
11001.description: When taking damage, your attack speed and attack are increased, but your defense is decreased.

11002.name: Mordschlag
11002.description: Hold the sword backwards and use its handle to smack down enemy.

11003.name: Double Pay Earn
11003.description: Doubles your EXP and reward when you defeat an enemy within a certain number of attacks. You take 3x damage while the effect is active, and lose more durability when you become incapable of combat.

11005.name: Cyclone
11005.description: Use centrifugal force and continuously attack enemies.

10501.name: Shield Charge
10501.description: Use shield and dash pushing away enemies. Enemies nearby falls down when hit.

10502.name: Montano
10502.description: Strongly attack bottom of enemy with chance of paralyzing.

10503.name: Targe Smash
10503.description: Smacks down an enemy using your shield, afflicting the [Dark] status effect by a small chance.

10504.name: Shield Push
10504.description:
Use shield to interrupt enemy.
Target falls under unbalanced status.

10507.name: Shield Shoving
10507.description: Interrupt an enemy's action using your shield. The enemy is turned around, and can't take any actions temporarily.

10508.name: Shield Bash
10508.description: Attack with the shield. The stat points of attacked enemy will mix temporarily.

10505.name: Slithering
10505.description: Hold key to bend down and move forward. Evasion increases and attacks enemy after moving.

10506.name: Shooting Star
10506.description: Use your shield and sword to successively attack enemies.

10509.name: High Kick
10509.required_stance: OneHandSwordArtefact, OneHandSwordShield, OneHandSwordDagger, OneHandSpearArtefact, OneHandSpearShield, OneHandSpearDagger, RapierAndShield, RapierAndDagger, RapierAndArtefact
10509.description: Perform a high kick on the enemy. The enemy will receive additional damage from Strike attacks temporarily.

10704.name: Arrest
10704.description: Binds all enemies, including boss monsters, to prevent them from moving.

10703.name: Repair
10703.description: Open shop for repairing items. Items are repaired to have higher durability than max. durability.

10701.name: Weapon Maintenance
10701.description: Open a shop to repair your weapon and temporarily increase its quality.

10702.name: Armor Maintenance
10702.description: Open a shop to repair your weapon and temporarily increase its quality. Can repair Tops, Pants and Shields.

10705.name: Base Camp
10705.description: Set up a basecamp for party members. Party members can use the basecamp as storage or for teleportation. Duration of buffs used around the camp will increase.

10706.name: Refreshment Table
10706.description: Sets up a refreshment table to prepare dishes that temporarily increases the abilities for your party members. A refreshment table can only be set up near the base camp, and if the camp is removed, the refreshment table will be removed as well.

11102.name: Lunge
11102.description: Thrust with your Rapier, lunging at the enemy. Evasion increases, and become less vulnerable to Slash damage (?).

11104.name: Attaque Coquile
11104.description: Attack the enemy using the Rapier guard. For a duration of time, enemy Pierce resistance is ignored.

11105.name: Esquive Toucher
11105.description: A complex attack which avoids enemy attacks whilst quickly moving forward, continuously attacking between dodges.

11107.name: Flanconnade
11107.description: [Physical] - [Slash]Perform a complex upward attack with your rapier. Temporarily increases your block rate.

11101.name: Attaque Composee
11101.description: Surge forward with your Rapier, dealing damage.

11106.name: Preparation
11106.description: Move your Rapier in small circular motions, ready to parry and counter-attack. The next Pierce attack after this skill hits twice.

20001.name: Energy Bolt
20001.description: Gather powerful magical energy to launch it towards the enemy. Increases the inflicted damage depending on the amount of gathered energy.

20003.name: Sleep
20003.description: Makes an enemy fall asleep. The enemy awakens once you've reached your limit of attacks.

20004.name: Reflect Shield
20004.description: Creates a protective shield that reflects the amplified damage to the enemy.

20005.name: Earthquake
20005.description: Inflicts damage on an enemy by causing a powerful earthquake.

20006.name: Surespell
20006.description: The casting of a skill won't be canceled when you are being attacked.

20007.name: Magic Missile
20007.description: Attack enemies consecutively by using magic bullets. An additional bullet is fired when attacking enemies who are asleep.

20101.name: Fireball
20101.description: Summons a fireball. Enemies touching the fireball will receive continuous flame damage.

20102.name: Fire Wall
20102.description: Creates a wall of flames that continuously damages approaching enemies.

20103.name: Enchant Fire
20103.description: Temporarily grants the fire property to you and your party member's attacks.

20104.name: Flare
20104.description: Inflicts damage by exploding a burning enemy.

20107.name: Flame Ground
20107.description: Creates a magic circle of flames at a targeted area. Deals continuous flame damage to enemies in the magic circle.

20105.name: Fire Pillar
20105.description: Summons a fire pillar to inflict damage on enemies.

20106.name: Hell Breath
20106.description: Attack by continuously fuming fire forward to enemies. Deals continuous flame damage to enemies.

20201.name: Ice Bolt
20201.description: Cast an arrow of ice that inflicts damage and has a chance of freezing the enemy.

20202.name: Ice Pike
20202.description: Make ice spikes sprout out in a line, inflicting damage and freezing enemies by chance.

20203.name: Ice Wall
20203.description: Create ice wall to trap enemy with chance of freezing nearby enemies.

20204.name: Ice Blast
20204.description: Inflicts damage on a frozen enemy in front of you. There is a small chance to remove freeze from the enemy when it takes damage.

20205.name: Subzero Shield
20205.description: Creates a curtain of ice for defense. Inflicts damage after successfully blocking an attack from an enemy. There is a certain chance to freeze nearby enemies.

20206.name: Gust
20206.description: Creates a strong gust of wind that pushes enemies. When inflicting damage on a frozen enemy, it will unfreeze.

20207.name: Snow Rolling
20207.description: Ride on an enormous snowball and crush any enemies in your way.

20208.name: Frost Pillar
20208.description: Summons a tree of ice on the ground to pull nearby targets in and freeze them by chance.

20301.name: Psychic Pressure
20301.description: Concentrate on the the tip of your hand to inflict continuous damage with psychokinesis.

20302.name: Telekinesis
20302.description:
Use psychokinesis to capture a target in front and throw it around.
Inflicts damage by throwing the captured target in a direction using your arrow keys.

20303.name: Swap
20303.description: Swaps your position with that of the enemy.

20305.name: Magnetic Force
20305.description: Move target to collide with another enemy.

20306.name: Raise
20306.description: Raise nearby enemies into the air. Enemies in the air are temporarily detected as flight type.

20307.name: Gravity Pole
20307.description: Creates a gravity field in front of you in a line that pulls nearby enemies into it.

21001.name: Combustion
21001.description: Explodes an item of yours on the ground to damage nearby enemies.

21002.name: Dig
21002.description: Dig up the ground to collect materials required for alchemy.

21003.name: Gem Roasting
21003.description: Open a shop to roast and enhance gems. Decreases the penalty of an enhanced gem.

21004.name: Briquetting
21004.description: Combine two items to change item abilities. Item loses potential and its ability may become better or worse.

21005.name: Tincturing
21005.description: Extract fluid from herbs to create different potions.

21006.name: Magnum Opus
21006.description: Use pluvial of alchemy and create a new item.

21007.name: Item Awakening
21007.description: Battle in another dimension to awaken an item's potential. You can use the item's hidden option when you win the battle, but its potential will be reduced.

20701.name: Summoning
20701.description: Summons a devil from the card placed in the Grimoire. The attack and defense of the summoned devil is affected by your INT and SPR. Increases the abilities by 10% proportional to the amount of stars of the card. Only Devil-type cards can be placed in the Grimoire.

20702.name: Attack Ground
20702.description: Orders the summoned devil from the Grimoire to move and attack in the targeted area.

20703.name: Riding
20703.description: Take control of the summoned devil from the Grimoire by riding it on top of its head.

20704.name: Morph
20704.description: Mutates the summoned devil from the Grimoire to the devil that is equipped as a secondary card in the Grimoire while maintaining its previous abilities.

20705.name: Hold
20705.description: Orders the summoned devil to wait and guard the targeted area.

20706.name: Summon Familiar
20706.description: Summons a familiar. The familiar rushes to an enemy that you attack or that attacks you, and then explodes itself.

20707.name: Summon Salamion
20707.description: Summons the fire devil Salamion. It follows its master and attacks enemies.

20708.name: Summon Servant
20708.description: Summons a servant. The servant will grant beneficial effects while following its master.

20402.name: Physical Link
20402.description: Link party members to divide damage taken.

20403.name: Joint Penalty
20403.description: Link enemies, so that they share damage taken.

20404.name: Hangman's Knot
20404.description: Tighten the link to gather up the linked enemies in front of you.

20405.name: Spiritual Chain
20405.description: Link party member and share buff effects.

20406.name: Life line
20406.description: Use the higher ability between you and ally linked by Spiritual Chain.

20801.name: Quicken
20801.description: Temporarily increases the attack speed of you and your party members by manipulating time.

20802.name: Reincarnate
20802.description: By manipulating time, you can let a monster appear at the same location where it was defeated.

20803.name: Stop
20803.description: Stop time of monsters within target area. Enemies do not receive damage when time is stopped.

20804.name: Slow
20804.description: Controls time to decrease the movement speed of enemies.

20805.name: Haste
20805.description: Temporarily increases the movement speed of you and your party members by manipulating time.

20806.name: Back Masking
20806.description: Control time in an area, temporarily changing it back to its previous state.

20902.name: Create Shoggoth
20902.description: Creates a Shoggoth based on the card placed in the Necronomicon. The attack and defense of the summoned devil is affected by your INT and SPR. Increases the abilities by 10% proportional to the amount of stars of the card. Only Animal, Plant and Mutant-type cards can be placed in the Necronomicon.

20903.name: Flesh Cannon
20903.description: Throw corpse parts to target area and attack nearby enemies.

20904.name: Flesh Hoop
20904.description: Encircle yourself with corpse parts that will damage nearby enemies.

20907.name: Dirty Pole
20907.description: [Magic]Creates a wall made with corpses. Enemies approaching near the wall will be afflicted with the Decay status effect.

20906.name: Disinter
20906.description: Collect the corpse left over from where an enemy died.

20908.name: Corpse Tower
20908.description: [Magic]Build a cursed tower made with corpses at a targeted area.

20909.name: Raise Dead
20909.description: [Magic]Summons a skeleton soldier made with a corpse. The skeleton soldier will engage in combat and follow its master.

20501.name: Swell Left Arm
20501.description: Enlarge the size of your and party member's hand and increase attack.

20503.name: Swell Body
20503.description: Enlarge size of target. Target's HP, EXP, drop rate is doubled

20506.name: Swell Right Arm
20506.description: Temporarily enlarge your party member's offhand, increasing attack if it is equipped with a shield or dagger.

20507.name: Swell Brain
20507.description: Enlarge the size of you and your party members' heads to increase INT.

20601.name: Electrocute
20601.description: Shoot Lightning chain that continuously attacks enemy.

20603.name: Hail
20603.description: Drop chunks of ice and continuously inflict damage to enemies.

20604.name: Prominence
20604.description: Summon Prominence. Summoned Prominence goes back and forth randomly and inflicts damage to targets.

20605.name: Meteor
20605.description: Drop meteors on the targeted area and inflict damage.

20607.name: Freezing Sphere
20607.description: Damages an enemy by throwing an Ice Sphere.

20606.name: Rain
20606.description: Let it rain in a targeted area. The rain provides various effects.

20608.name: Frost Cloud
20608.description: Creates a magic circle of ice at a targeted area. Deals continuous ice damage to enemies in the magic circle.

30004.name: Swift Step
30004.description: Temporarily increases your movement speed while attacking.

30001.name: Multi Shot
30001.description: Charge up and then quickly launch multiple shots at a targeted location.

30002.name: Full Draw
30002.description: Fires a shot that penetrates enemies. Enemies close to one another may be skewered together.

30005.name: Oblique Shot
30005.description: Fires a shot that ricochets to a nearby enemy.

30003.name: Kneeling Shot
30003.description: Kneel to increase focus. Increases your attack, range and attack speed.

30006.name: Heavy Shot
30006.description: Demonstrate your strength by firing a shot that pushes enemies away.

30401.name: Coursing
30401.description: Your companion bites and holds onto a target. Decreases the physical defense of the bitten target. You receive a critical chance bonus against the target.

30402.name: Snatching
30402.description: Your Companion bites Flying-type enemies and drags them to the ground.

30404.name: Praise
30404.description: Temporarily increases your Companion's Attack, Accuracy and Critical Rate.

30405.name: Pointing
30405.description: The companion paces around the target and fixes its target. Evasion and Accuracy of the target will be decreased.

30403.name: Rush Dog
30403.description: Order your companion to rush forward and attack the enemy.

30406.name: Retrieve
30406.description: Companion bites the target and brings it to the player.

30407.name: Hounding
30407.description: Your Companion finds hidden nearby enemies.

30408.name: Growling
30408.description: Your companion intimidates the enemy and prevents it from approaching. Enemies may fall under Fear.

30201.name: Deploy Pavise
30201.description: Deploys an upright shield to block hostile enemies and their ranged attacks.

30202.name: Scatter Caltrops
30202.description: Throw caltrops on the ground that inflict damage to enemies that step on them.

30203.name: Stone Picking
30203.description: Collect stones to use as bullets for Stone Shot. Stones cannot be obtained in towns.

30204.name: Stone Shot
30204.description: Fires a stone-bullet that knocks back the target. The target has a chance to be stunned.

30205.name: Rapid Fire
30205.description: Charge crossbow with multiple arrows and shoot towards enemy.

30206.name: Teardown
30206.description: Demolish obstacles in front, inflicting damage to nearby enemies.

30207.name: Running Shot
30207.description: Attack with your crossbow while moving quickly.

30101.name: Barrage
30101.description: Shoot 5 arrows forward in an arc towards the ground.

30102.name: High Anchoring
30102.description: Penetrate straight through the enemy by aiming with the tip of your arrow.

30103.name: Critical Shot
30103.description: Shoot an arrow with a high critical chance.

30104.name: Steady Aim
30104.description: Increases skill damage while decreasing attack speed.

30105.name: Time Bomb Arrow
30105.description: Fires an arrow with a bomb attached. The arrow explodes after a short amount of time causing additional damage.

30106.name: Bounce Shot
30106.description: Launches an arrow that splits into multiple pieces and ricochets to nearby enemies.

30107.name: Spiral Arrow
30107.description: Attacks the enemy with a spiraling arrow that penetrates and inflicts multiple strikes.

30301.name: Stake Stockades
30301.description: Lay a defensive trap that damages any enemies that walk into it.

30305.name: Conceal
30305.description: Hide a prepared trap from enemies.

30302.name: Claymore
30302.description: Set up a trap that shoots buckshot. Trap is triggered using a detonator.

30303.name: Punji Stake
30303.description: Set up a trap that launches enemies back when stepped on.

30304.name: Detonate Traps
30304.description: Detonates nearby traps and magic circles to deal damage to enemies.

30306.name: Broom Trap
30306.description: Set up a rotating trap that inflicts damage to enemies within a radius.

30307.name: Collar Bomb
30307.description: Attach a bomb to an enemy. The enemy explodes when it comes in contact with other enemies.

30308.name: Spike Shooter
30308.description: Set up a trap that shoots arrows when an enemy touches the wire.

30501.name: Detoxify
30501.description: Cures a poisoned ally. A poison status with a higher level than Detoxify cannot be healed, however its duration decreases.

30502.name: Needle Blow
30502.description: Blow toxic arrow and inflict continuous damage.

30503.name: Bewitch
30503.description: Inflicts confusion on a poisoned enemy.

30504.name: Wugong Gu
30504.description: Launches a contagious poisonous arrow. Poison spreads through the target whenever it gets attacked.

30507.name: Zhendu
30507.description: Applies a poison once to the weapon of you and your party members for the next attack.

30505.name: Throw Gu Pot
30505.description: Throw jar of Poison to create poisonous puddle. Enemies become poisoned when stepping on the puddle.

30506.name: Jincan Gu
30506.description: Throw poison to inject a parasite into the enemy. Poisonous insects are born when the host is killed.

30601.name: Camouflage
30601.description: Hide yourself in an empty container. Blocks against a few Physical attacks.

30602.name: Flu Flu
30602.description: Shoot arrow that makes noise. Enemies nearby falls under fear.

30603.name: Flare Shot
30603.description: Shoot flash arrows on the ground. Flash pops and shoots sparks to enemies nearby.

30604.name: Cloaking
30604.description: Temporarily hide yourself away from enemy's vision. You become exposed when jumping or attacking.

30605.name: Perspective Distortion
30605.description: Distort sense of distance and make attack of allies possible outside the range.

30606.name: Scan
30606.description: Show hidden items and enemies within range.

30608.name: Split Arrow
30608.description: Deals damage to two nearby enemies with a bouncing arrow once an attack lands.

30701.name: Sneak Hit
30701.description: Temporarily increases your Critical Chance when attacking enemies from behind.

30702.name: Feint
30702.description: Trick an enemy to lower its guard. Temporarily decreases the evasion of enemies in front of you.

30703.name: Capture
30703.description: Steals the enemy's trap and magic circle. You may use it later when you need it.

30704.name: Vendetta
30704.description: Temporarily increases the STR of you and your party members when a target dies and explodes from this attack.

30706.name: Burrow
30706.description: Hide underground to conceal your appearance. In this state you can attack but cannot move.

30707.name: Lachrymator
30707.description: Throw tear gas on target area. Target falls under Darkness.

30708.name: Backstab
30708.description: Continuously attack using your dagger. A double attack with a high critical rate that may stun the enemy.

30901.name: Concentrated Fire
30901.description: Fires multiple bullets toward the enemy.

30903.name: Limacon
30903.description: Use speed to move fast while attacking when riding on top.

30904.name: Retreat Shot
30904.description: Shoot in the opposite direction you are moving.

30801.name: Broadhead
30801.description: Launches a wide broadhead arrow. Inflicts bleeding on the enemy hit.

30802.name: Bodkin Point
30802.description: Launches a bodkin arrow that deeply penetrates the enemy. On hit, decreases enemies' defense and nullifies the magic that protects the enemy.

30803.name: Barbed Arrow
30803.description: Launches a barbed arrow. The number of strikes depends on the enemy's defense type.

30804.name: Crossfire
30804.description: Launches an arrow that explodes on enemy impact in a cross.

30805.name: Magic Arrow
30805.description: Flame fumes from area shot with arrow and attacks enemy.

30806.name: Singijeon
30806.description: Launches an arrow with explosives attached. Upon hitting its target, the arrow will explode after an amount of time and cause additional collateral damage.

31002.name: 횃대 설치
31002.description: Set up a perch where the hawk can sit. The hawk will wait for the owner's order on the perch. The perch disappears when you move away from it.

31003.name: Circling
31003.description: Hawk will encircle a targeted area. Decreases the AoE defense ratio of the target within the radius.

31004.name: Hovering
31004.description: Your hawk circles above a targeted area and attacks enemies passing below.

31005.name: Pheasant
31005.description: Throw a training doll and have your hawk attack the targeted area.

31006.name: Hanging Shot
31006.description: Have your hawk carry you. While being carried, you can inflict damage to enemies below using your basic attacks without being harmed.

31101.name: Cannon Shot
31101.description: Fires a shell to targeted enemies on the ground. Deals 50% damage on Flying-type enemies.

31102.name: Shootdown
31102.description: Fires a shell to targeted airborne enemies. Deals 50% damage on enemies on the ground.

31103.name: Siege Burst
31103.description: Fire on the ground using a howitzer. Enemies hit by the fire will knock down and deals 5x damage to the enemy's structure.

31104.name: Cannon Blast
31104.description: Deals damage to multiple enemies by launching a cannon in an arc shape towards the ground.

40001.name: Heal
40001.description: Creates a magic circle in front of you, healing allies or damaging enemies. Does not affect airborne enemies. Amount of HP recovered depends on target's maximum HP.

40002.name: Cure
40002.description: Creates a magic circle that removes a Lv1 abnormal status from allies or inflicts damage to enemies. Does not apply to airborne enemies.

40003.name: Safety Zone
40003.description: Creates a magic circle that blocks incoming attacks.

40004.name: Deprotected Zone
40004.description: Creates a magic circle that decreases the defense of enemies over time.

40005.name: Divine Might
40005.description: Temporarily increases the skill level of you and your party members by 1.

40006.name: Fade
40006.description: Erase sign to remove monsters' threat and is not attacked first by monsters.

40007.name: Guardian Saint
40007.description: Create Guardian Saint magic circle. Target receives damage instead of skill caster.

40201.name: Aspersion
40201.description: Sprinkle holy water to help increase the physical defense of you and your allies and to inflict damage to enemies.

40202.name: Monstrance
40202.description: Creates a magic circle in front of you that increases DEX of allies while decreasing the enemy's evasion and physical defense. Party members will receive the effect without stepping on the magic circle.

40203.name: Blessing
40203.description: Gives a blessing granting additional damage to the attacks of your party members and allies.

40204.name: Resurrection
40204.description: Resurrects a target that has been defeated in combat.

40205.name: Sacrament
40205.description: Temporarily grants an additional holy property attack to you and your party member's attacks.

40206.name: Revive
40206.description: Prevents you from becoming Incapable of Combat once.

40209.name: Mass Heal
40209.description: Restores the HP of you and that of your allies in front of you.

40207.name: Exorcise
40207.description: Creates an exorcism circle that damages enemies inside, then deals continuous damage.

40210.name: Stone Skin
40210.description: Temporarily increases the number of blocks of you and your party members.

40101.name: Aukuras
40101.description: Summons a holy torch, improving the HP recovery of nearby allies. Decreases the accuracy of nearby enemies.

40102.name: Zalciai
40102.description: Creates a magic circle that increases the critical abilities of allies or decreases the critical abilities of enemies.

40103.name: Daino
40103.description: Increases the number of beneficial effects that you and your party members can receive.

40104.name: Zaibas
40104.description: Creates a magic circle that calls down bolts of lightning on an enemy using the God of Thunder's power.

40105.name: Divine Stigma
40105.description: Engraves a stigma on an enemy. Increases the STR and INT of you and your party members when the engraved enemy has been defeated.

40106.name: Melstis
40106.description: Creates a magic circle that temporarily maintains the beneficial effects of you and your party members.

40301.name: Hexing
40301.description: Curses an enemy to decrease its magic defense and prevent recovery.

40302.name: Effigy
40302.description: Controls an enemy afflicted by a curse and inflicts damage from afar. Bonus damage is dealt on the 3rd attack.

40303.name: Tet Mamak La
40303.description: Use a monkey skull to lure zombies to the desired location.

40304.name: Zombify
40304.description: Creates a magic circle that raises a dead enemy as a zombie. The HP of the raised zombie is based on the caster's SPR.

40305.name: Mackangdal
40305.description: Throws a talisman to an ally that temporarily suppresses pain. Ally is invulnerable to any damage when the talisman is enabled, but receives the accumulated damage at once when the effect ends.

40306.name: Bwa Kayiman
40306.description: Instruct your summoned zombies to celebrate. The zombies will deal little damage to anything they touch.

40307.name: Samediveve
40307.description: Plants a Samedi glyph on the ground symbolizing a death noir. Increases the maximum HP and movement speed of you and your zombies nearby the glyph. Only half of the effect applies to you.

40308.name: Ogouveve
40308.description: You will set the pattern which represent Ogu which is the Rwa of Power on the ground. STR of the zombies nearby this pattern will be increased.

40309.name: Damballa
40309.description: Detonates zombies near the targeted area and deals damage to nearby enemies.

40906.name: Chortasmata
40906.description: Grass temporarily grows on the targeted area. Monsters within the targeted area become Plant-type monsters.

40902.name: Carnivory
40902.description: Grass near the targeted area attacks the enemy. It casts in the place of Chortasmata first if it exists, otherwise it casts on you.

40905.name: Sterea Trofh
40905.description: Grown grass protects you and your party. It casts in the place of Chortasmata first if exists, otherwise it casts on you.

40904.name: Transform
40904.description: Transform back into the monster that you last shape shifted to.

40903.name: Shape Shifting
40903.description: Temporarily transform into an Animal-type, Plant-type or Insect-type monster in front.

40901.name: Telepath
40901.description: Penetrate into the mind of an enemy in front and control it.

40501.name: Out of Body
40501.description: Move your spirit out of the body. The spirit can only move near the body.

40502.name: Prakriti
40502.description: Move body to the spirit to unite again. Can only be used when spirit is out of body.

40504.name: Astral Body Explosion
40504.description: Explode the souls separated from the body and inflict damage.

40503.name: Vashita Siddhi
40503.description: Decreases the STR, CON, INT, SPR and DEX of enemies nearby.

40505.name: Possession
40505.description: Bind enemy to stop its movement and inflict damage.

40506.name: Transmit Prana
40506.description: Transfer your abilities to allies in front of you.

40401.name: Statue of Goddess Vakarine
40401.description: You may warp to other areas through the Goddess Statue.

40402.name: Statue of Goddess Zemyna
40402.description: Decreases the SP cost for allies who are within the radius of the Goddess Statue.

40403.name: Statue of Goddess Laima
40403.description: Decreases the cooldown of your party members' skills within the radius of the Goddess Statue.

40404.name: Carve
40404.description: Attack the target by using a carving knife. Plant-type monsters take additional bonus damage and may drop statue materials.

40405.name: Carve Owl
40405.description: 전방의 적을 공격하는 수호의 부엉이상을 조각합니다.

40406.name: Carve Austras Koks
40406.description: Carves a divine world tree that silences nearby enemies.

40407.name: Statue of Goddess Ausrine
40407.description: Carve a sculpture of Ausrine, the Goddess of the Morning Star. Those in your party who circle around the sculpture counter-clockwise are granted divine protection and become immune to damage temporarily.

41002.name: Arcane Energy
41002.description: Increases your and your party member's maximum SP and STA.

41003.name: Change
41003.description: Change the monster in front to a different monster.

41004.name: Clairvoyance
41004.description: Predict and show beforehand which item the monster will drop

41005.name: Counter Spell
41005.description: 자신 주변의 모든 마법을 무효화 시킵니다.

41006.name: Forecast
41006.description: Preview the area where enemy will attack.

41007.name: Resetting
41007.description: Change enemy's drop item. Notify when item is changed.

41008.name: Death Sentence
41008.description: Sentence death to enemy. Target dies when time is up.

41009.name: Prophecy
41009.description: Grants a temporary effect preventing Lv. 1 abnormal status effects to nearby party members.

40701.name: Iron Skin
40701.description: Train your skin as hard as steel to inflict damage by bouncing off the enemy's attack.

40702.name: Double Punch
40702.description: Use your trained fists to attack the enemy in succession.

40703.name: Palm Strike
40703.description: With trained fingers attack by inflicting internal damage to the enemy.

40704.name: Hand Knife
40704.description: Use hand knife to destroy the shield.

40706.name: Energy Blast
40706.description: Gather energy and blast it forward. Enemies take damage and are pushed away.

40705.name: 1 Inch Punch
40705.description: Punch enemy from a close range. Enemy loses SP and receives continuous damage.

40707.name: God Finger Flick
40707.description: Use tip of finger to throw coin and attack enemy.

40708.name: Golden Bell Shield
40708.description: Temporarily become invincible from all attacks.

40801.name: Simony
40801.description: Craft your skill into a scroll that anyone can use.

40802.name: Indulgentia
40802.description: Use a ritual to heal allies with a level 2 abnormal state or to inflict damage on enemies.

40803.name: Discerning Evil
40803.description: Extend the duration of harmful effects applied to the enemy.

40808.name: Increase Magic DEF
40808.description: Temporarily increases the magic defense of you and your party members.

40804.name: Oblation
40804.description: Open an Offering Box to receive donations from allies. Can only be opened nearby a Goddess Statue.

40805.name: Spell Shop
40805.description: Create a shop to sell your skills.

40602.name: Restoration
40602.description: Activate aura and increase HP recovery of allies nearby.

40603.name: Resist Elements
40603.description: You and your party members are temporarily granted an increase in fire, ice, lightning, poison, and earth resistances, and have a chance of nullifying attacks from those properties.

40604.name: Turn Undead
40604.description: May defeat mutant or devil-type enemy at once.

40605.name: Conversion
40605.description: Enemies attacked have chance of creating a magic circle of conversion.

40606.name: Barrier
40606.description: Pushes the enemies outside and creates the wall of protection which doesn't allow others to enter for some time. It will increase DEF of the allies inside the wall.

40607.name: Conviction
40607.description: Attacks an enemy as an attack for the betrayer. Resistance to Fire, Ice, Electricity, Poison of the enemy that received the attack will decrease.
